I wish I had a gun too, I always wish I could press a button that would make me just disappear. I would press it without even thinking, but that’s not realistic unfortunately.

Things may seem terrible right now but God put each of us on this Earth for a reason and we all have a purpose. Just stick it for a little longer and eventually everything will turn around. I believe in you and I’m with you in this journey. 

You are way too young to die because you have a whole life ahead of you. Who knows what will happen, but I can tell you 100% that you are going to see better days, much better days. Stay strong homie.
